Hello, my name is Paromita Sengupta. I grew up in Bangladesh and later moved to Canada to pursue my undergraduate degree at the University of Saskatchewan, where I graduated with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science. Before starting the Master of Data Science program at UBC, I worked in the Canadian tech industry as a full-stack software engineer, building web applications and data-driven systems. Through the MDS program, I hope to strengthen my skills in data science, machine learning, and AI. After graduating, I hope to apply these skills to practical, data-focused technical projects in Canada.
